chemistry-killer-02.title: N'okpomọkụ na nrụgide edoro,
chemistry-killer-02.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-killer-02.material:
N'okpomọkụ na nrụgide edoro, hydrogen ($\mathrm{H_2}$) na oxygen ($\mathrm{O_2}$) na-emeghachi omume ka ha mepụta uzuoku mmiri ($\mathrm{H_2O}$(g)). Mgbe e mere ka ngwakọta gas dị iche iche meghachi omume kpamkpam, ngụkọta olu gas e tụrụ n'otu okpomọkụ na nrụgide bụ nke a (uzuoku mmiri niile bụ gas):
(A) $\mathrm{H_2}$ 30 mL + $\mathrm{O_2}$ 20 mL → ngụkọta mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị 35 mL
(B) $\mathrm{H_2}$ 20 mL + $\mathrm{O_2}$ 20 mL → ngụkọta mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị 30 mL
Mgbe e mere ka 60 mL nke ngwakọta gas $\mathrm{H_2}$ na $\mathrm{O_2}$ meghachi omume kpamkpam n'otu okpomọkụ na nrụgide, ngụkọta olu gas mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị bụ 45 mL, ma naanị $\mathrm{O_2}$ fọdụrụ ($\mathrm{H_2}$ anaghị fọdụ). Kedu nhọrọ na-ekekọta nke ọma olu $\mathrm{H_2}$ tupu mmeghachi omume na olu $\mathrm{O_2}$ fọdụrụ mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị, n'usoro?
chemistry-killer-02.s.s1.prompt:
N'okpomọkụ na nrụgide edoro, hydrogen ($\mathrm{H_2}$) na oxygen ($\mathrm{O_2}$) na-emeghachi omume ka ha mepụta uzuoku mmiri ($\mathrm{H_2O}$(g)). Mgbe e mere ka ngwakọta gas dị iche iche meghachi omume kpamkpam, ngụkọta olu gas e tụrụ n'otu okpomọkụ na nrụgide bụ nke a (uzuoku mmiri niile bụ gas):
(A) $\mathrm{H_2}$ 30 mL + $\mathrm{O_2}$ 20 mL → ngụkọta mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị 35 mL
(B) $\mathrm{H_2}$ 20 mL + $\mathrm{O_2}$ 20 mL → ngụkọta mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị 30 mL
Mgbe e mere ka 60 mL nke ngwakọta gas $\mathrm{H_2}$ na $\mathrm{O_2}$ meghachi omume kpamkpam n'otu okpomọkụ na nrụgide, ngụkọta olu gas mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị bụ 45 mL, ma naanị $\mathrm{O_2}$ fọdụrụ ($\mathrm{H_2}$ anaghị fọdụ). Kedu nhọrọ na-ekekọta nke ọma olu $\mathrm{H_2}$ tupu mmeghachi omume na olu $\mathrm{O_2}$ fọdụrụ mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị, n'usoro?
chemistry-killer-02.s.s1.explain:
Nzọụkwụ 1: Chọpụta ọnụọgụ olu site na (A), (B). (B): H2 20 mL na-emeghachi omume na O2 10 mL ka ọ mepụta H2O 20 mL, O2 10 mL fọdụrụ → ngụkọta 30 mL. (A): H2 30 mL na-emeghachi omume na O2 15 mL ka ọ mepụta H2O 30 mL, O2 5 mL fọdụrụ → ngụkọta 35 mL. Ya mere ọnụọgụ olu mmeghachi omume $\mathrm{H_2:O_2:H_2O(g)} = 2:1:2$.
Nzọụkwụ 2: Tupu mmeghachi omume 60 mL, mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị 45 mL, ya mere mbelata bụ 15 mL. Na mmeghachi omume, olu gas 3 na-aghọ olu 2, ya mere olu 1 na-ebelata, ma ebe olu mbelata = olu $\mathrm{O_2}$ meghachiri, $\mathrm{O_2}$ meghachiri = 15 mL.
Nzọụkwụ 3: Ebe $\mathrm{H_2}$ anaghị fọdụ, H2 niile meghachiri: 15×2 = 30 mL. H2O(g) a mepụtara = 30 mL. Ebe ngụkọta mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị bụ 45 mL, $\mathrm{O_2}$ fọdụrụ = 45 − 30 = 15 mL. $\mathrm{O_2}$ tupu mmeghachi omume = 15 + 15 = 30 mL, ngụkọta 30 + 30 = 60 mL kwekọrọ.
Azịza: 30 mL, 15 mL (b).
